Identity/date/authorship derive from that retained record rather than the pixels. Original and rights hashes were already checked in this same role; the bound JPEG remains unchanged. The photo is secondary macro context, makes no Bitcoin/current-meeting/demand claim and is not used by the eight social image selections.
